scope: Pinned unmodified UniTimer header in a standalone CPU process; compare RAW-based reported epoch to REALTIME brackets and BOOTTIME-RAW delta. This does not align an old or model trace.
raw_mode_qualification: CPU-only pinned UniTimer header reports CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW exactly when UNITRACE_SystemTime=1. This is an internal flag; actual GPU trace in that mode is not yet qualified. Future collectors must record matching RAW bounds rather than relabel RAW as UTC.
